description: Per-ad performance within one ad group, joined with each ad's name and creative headline and sorted by spend - answers 'which creative is winning?' in one call. Money metrics in USD. Scoped to a single ad group: use get_performance_report for account-level totals.

account_id.description: Ad account id. Falls back to REDDIT_ADS_ACCOUNT_ID.

ad_group_id.description: Ad group whose ads to compare.

days.description: Trailing days to report over. Default 30.

metrics.description: Friendly metric names. Default: a useful spend+conversions set.

name: compare_ads
